scope: 25 distinct validation and evidence interventions; these are not 25 agents or 25 proven profitable strategies.

interventions.intervention: Preserve the complete search ledger
interventions.rationale: Supported selection controls require every attempted configuration, failed run, and zero-trade outcome to remain visible; reporting only the maximum over 100 trials inflates perceived skill.
interventions.testability: Assert exactly the registered configuration IDs occur in output and output cannot silently skip exceptions.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Keep the chronology and deterministic selection frozen
interventions.rationale: Selection must consume only development observations and use a fixed tie break; subsequent windows measure the frozen choice.
interventions.testability: Repeat selection with truncated development data and compare candidate ID and source hashes.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Relabel familiar windows as exploratory diagnostics
interventions.rationale: These calendar dates were reused by earlier searches; chronological ordering cannot restore untouched evidence.
interventions.testability: Require historyPreviouslyReused=true and prohibit prospective or untouched labels in generated output.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Measure the frozen candidate on subsequently collected data
interventions.rationale: Only subsequent observations can resolve whether a reused-data winner's edge persists; existing 2025–2026 data cannot supply them.
interventions.testability: Freeze signal, costs, sizing, horizon and evaluation criteria before collecting a future paper ledger.
interventions.statusMeaning: Necessary assessment cannot be resolved from the shared daily dataset alone.

interventions.intervention: Retain zero-yield cash as the non-trading benchmark
interventions.rationale: All previous daily candidates lost in the final period; rejecting a losing strategy may be better than increasing activity.
interventions.testability: Assert cash has zero trades, fees, drawdown and net P&L in every scenario and window.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Add equally funded BTC and ETH buy-and-hold comparisons
interventions.rationale: A bullish interval can make many rules profitable without positive timing value; each benchmark must use the same allocation, fill costs and liquidation convention.
interventions.testability: Compute paired daily net excess for each strategy and fixed-unit benchmark under identical accounting.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Require exact runtime replay before replacing the runtime
interventions.rationale: The daily evaluator lacks the runtime's 40-native-week state, 0.1%-equity entry sizing, marked cap and account halt; daily candidates do not demonstrate runtime improvement.
interventions.testability: Use native weekly warmup and replay matching runtime rules, then compare order intentions and ledger outcomes for representative prefixes.
interventions.statusMeaning: Necessary assessment cannot be resolved from the shared daily dataset alone.

interventions.intervention: Report total-account returns alongside allocation returns
interventions.rationale: A $1,000 research entry against $10,000 cash differs greatly from the runtime's initial $100 against $100,000; allocation returns are not account returns.
interventions.testability: Check P&L divided by account capital and entry budget independently; print denominators and actual maximum exposure.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Independently reconstruct cash from all fills
interventions.rationale: Profitable-looking realized P&L can omit fee-funded basis or open liabilities; common.py currently reconciles trade P&L and terminal cash correctly.
interventions.testability: Reconstruct cash and inventory from signed fills and fees; compare summed daily P&L, trade P&L and terminal liquidated equity.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Present a risk/return frontier using two drawdown measures
interventions.rationale: Daily-close drawdown misses losses within a day; sampled prior-peak-to-low drawdown is useful but is not full intraday high-to-low drawdown.
interventions.testability: Retain net, close drawdown and sampled low drawdown separately and show nondominated configurations without scalarizing away risk.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Make the entry cap explicit in sizing sensitivities
interventions.rationale: common.py hardcodes cash*0.1 in spend; increasing its budget argument alone above 10% cash does not increase allocation.
interventions.testability: On synthetic high-volume flat prices show identical initial fills for budget=1000 and budget=10000 against capital=10000; disclose binding cap.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Run same-signal fee sensitivity before treating costs as the sole cause
interventions.rationale: Prior daily candidates still lost with zero commissions, so fee cuts alone did not solve those signals.
interventions.testability: Hold target sequence and timing fixed while varying per-side fee; retain adverse price costs and report each candidate's break-even fee.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Verify the actual applicable account fee tier
interventions.rationale: 80 bps per side is a configured paper assumption; lower real fees might change economics but should not be invented from nominal capital.
interventions.testability: Obtain product- and account-specific fee evidence before substituting a cheaper execution scenario.
interventions.statusMeaning: Necessary assessment cannot be resolved from the shared daily dataset alone.

interventions.intervention: Separate price-cost stress from execution-delay stress
interventions.rationale: Combined delay and fees may improve results because a later market price is favorable; it is not necessarily the worst scenario.
interventions.testability: Evaluate base, same-delay higher fees/slippage, same-cost extra delay, and combined stress; display all four.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Version instrument rules and expose historical-rule assumptions
interventions.rationale: Current tick, lot and minimum rules applied to past candles need explicit labeling; historical executability is not independently known.
interventions.testability: Bind current rules with hashes and test rule sensitivity; historical-rule validation requires contemporaneous rule archives.
interventions.statusMeaning: Necessary assessment cannot be resolved from the shared daily dataset alone.

interventions.intervention: Separate strategy exits from forced terminal liquidation
interventions.rationale: A forced final close converts a long open holding to an episode; it is not evidence the strategy found an executable exit at that timestamp.
interventions.testability: Count target-change exits separately from terminal exits and align final valuation time across all competing implementations.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Bind every result to immutable data and source files
interventions.rationale: Reusing a report after code or normalized data changes can silently make its audit obsolete.
interventions.testability: Verify dataset, raw sources, rules, evaluator, candidate generator, protocol and output hashes before accepting a result bundle.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Check prefix invariance for every candidate
interventions.rationale: Future bars must not alter historical targets; checking only a family winner misses defects in the other search trials.
interventions.testability: For all 100 configurations compare full-history prefix targets against targets recomputed on several truncated histories.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Use only finalized volume at each execution decision
interventions.rationale: The daily evaluator correctly uses i-2 volume at open i because i-1 has not passed the one-minute finalization delay.
interventions.testability: Mutate i-1 volume and all future values and assert the current fill is unchanged; retain i-2 or earlier for participation sizing.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Validate fills against synchronized executable books
interventions.rationale: OHLC opens and daily volume cannot prove spread, depth, acceptance, fill probability or executable protective exits; daily sells currently always fill.
interventions.testability: Collect timestamped L2 plus intent/submission/fill receipts, replay IOC limits and partial fills, and compare realized shortfall to candle proxies.
interventions.statusMeaning: Necessary assessment cannot be resolved from the shared daily dataset alone.

interventions.intervention: Retain unfilled, minimum-size and partial-order outcomes
interventions.rationale: Discarding rejections can falsely increase coverage and lower costs; the runtime already models these outcomes while common.py simplifies execution.
interventions.testability: Reconcile attempted orders to rejected/canceled/partial/filled states; preserve dust and do not erase inventory that cannot be sold.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Stress contribution concentration across episodes and calendar blocks
interventions.rationale: Prior rotation validation depended on one large ETH gain; a few long episodes do not constitute many independent bets.
interventions.testability: Report largest trade/month contribution, remove-best-episode net, active days and distinct completed strategy exits.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Treat multiple-trial bootstrap intervals as descriptive
interventions.rationale: A 100-candidate screen and unknown earlier trials require stronger interpretation limits than the prior study's 12-trial adjustment; dependence and sparse episodes remain.
interventions.testability: Use paired calendar-block resampling, retain cash days and a deterministic seed, disclose all trial counts and test several predeclared block lengths.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Check neighboring parameters and period boundaries
interventions.rationale: An isolated lookback optimum can be noise; neighboring lookbacks and modest boundary shifts help reveal fragility without converting reused data to fresh validation.
interventions.testability: Retain family curves across all registered lookbacks and show adjacent-parameter outcomes plus predeclared calendar subperiod diagnostics.
interventions.statusMeaning: Supported as a validation improvement or existing invariant, not proof of a profitable strategy.

interventions.intervention: Increase order frequency or capital as a standalone profit fix
interventions.rationale: More exposure scales negative net expectancy; prior daily candidates lost even with zero commissions, and synthetic flat-price round trips lose after fees.
interventions.testability: Compare unchanged-price round trips and fee-scaled sensitivities; require positive measured expectancy before treating scale or activity as beneficial.
interventions.statusMeaning: Rejected as a standalone remedy for profitability.
